title: oxalis semiloba subsp. uhehensis
intro: Oxalis semiloba subsp. uhehensis, commonly known as the Yellow Wood Sorrel, is a plant species in the Oxalidaceae family. It is a perennial herb with various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis semiloba subsp. uhehensis include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to remove excess fluids from the body, and as an antiseptic, aiding in wound healing and preventing infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
